body.text: Combine Fossilized Drake with Fossilized Bird to restore Dracozolt.
Combine Fossilized Drake with Fossilized Fish to restore Dracovish.

sections.heading: Choice Context

body.text: Dracovish is the strongest general-purpose choice. Dracozolt is the next most straightforward offensive option.

body: All four are revived at level 10 and need substantial training when first obtained.

sections.heading: Dracozolt

body.text: Dracozolt has good overall bulk and Attack. Bolt Beak becomes extremely strong when Dracozolt moves first, but the move arrives late, and a revived level-10 fossil needs significant training before it catches up with the team.

body: Train it until it catches up, favor accurate physical moves, and use speed support if building around Bolt Beak.
Powerful after investment, but less immediately convenient than its final stats suggest.

sections.heading: Dracovish

body.text: Dracovish is the most broadly useful Galar fossil. Its Water/Dragon typing has few weaknesses, and Strong Jaw makes Fishious Rend devastating when Dracovish moves first. It still begins at level 10 and does not learn Fishious Rend until late.

body: Use reliable physical Water and Dark coverage while training it. Once Fishious Rend is available, prioritize moving first through levels, speed control, or held items.
The safest general recommendation among the four Galar combinations.

body.text: Sword/Shield: Revive at Cara Liss fossil machine in Route 6. Revives at level 10.
